dogecoin.text: #ThursdayTrivia Do you know the name of the popular cryptocurrency based on a meme? The answer is #Dogecoin which was created as a parody based on a popular internet meme. At the height of the bull market, it was worth more than $1 billion! #Cryptocurrency #Blockchain #Broctagon https://t.co/BniuVgsP6n

In this feature by @Forbes, @BroctagonGroup CEO Don Guo comments on SHIB's sudden growth, explains why #SHIB can never attain the $1 price point, and expresses how its status as a #memecoin may in the long run prove to be its eventual downfall. #liquidity https://t.co/iEcqSmyW3w
